answer_1.quote: We evaluate AdvSeq by extensive experiments on three generation tasks: text summarization, table-to-text, and dialogue generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries, table-to-text sentences, and dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: We apply ROUGE F1 to evaluate text summarization, BLEU for table-to-text. For dialogue generation, we report the perplexity of generating reference response y to evaluate informativeness. We also use FactCC and QuestEval for factuality and PARENT for table-to-text faithfulness.

answer_4.quote: We recruit two human annotators from a professional data annotation team to evaluate our generated text in both informativeness and faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge whether each generated text is better than, tied with, or worse than the baseline model on informativeness and faithfulness.
